Residential · VIC

The International, Brighton

Completed project
Brighton, Melbourne
Delivery modelConstruction management
ApartmentsApprox. 55
Above ground5 storeys
Basements2

Considered delivery, through to completion.

Construction and Development

BOW was the construction manager for The International, Brighton, a five-storey apartment building of around 55 apartments over a two-level basement, with a ground floor cafe to Bay Street and a rooftop garden. Through construction and the defects period BOW certified progress payments, assessed variations and extensions of time, chaired the project control group, monitored programme, quality and consultants, and closed out defects. The project is complete.

Scope and delivery

  • Progress payment certification
  • Variations and extension-of-time assessment
  • Project control group and programme monitoring
  • Quality, consultant coordination and defects close-out
